title: U.S. Rushes Military Assets to Middle East as Negotiations Falter
author: Murtaza Hussain
content:
In this week's War Brief, Sarmad Jawad and Murtaza Hussain discuss how Iran
succeeded in its military strategy to inflict political damage on Donald Trump
and the Republicans, what that means for the war now and how the US is rushing
military assets to the region in anticipation of a new round of fighting.

They also cover the latest in the Saudi Arabia-Yemen war, where Saudi
warplanes hit civilian targets in two different incidents, leading to the
death of over 50 civilians.

Meanwhile in Ukraine, Russia continues its campaign to take out electricity
across Ukraine in a bid to make cities uninhabitable in the cold winter
months.
